tools.name: computegrid_list_agents
tools.description: List the 15-agent compute grid fleet across all 6 driver types. Returns agent type, count, and revenue model. No auth required.

tools.name: computegrid_get_capacity
tools.description: Read-only capacity view from the Capacity Listener fleet. Per spec section 8: NO bids, NO hedges, NO positions, NO derivatives — pure read-only telemetry.

tools.name: computegrid_verify_proof
tools.description: Submit a compute job for verification by the Verification Fleet (4 agents). Returns Groth16-style proof. $0.001/proof in USDC.
